Christofer Sanguesa Aguirre, Fabiana Prado Scatarzi, Santana Arturo Castillo Gonzalez, Felipe Andres Del Valle Munoz, Carlos Alfredo Calderon Valencia, Diego Antonio Calderon Leiva, and Pedro Alejandro Salgado Vallejos, all of Chile, were each charged by criminal complaint in January 2025 and each pleaded guilty to conspiracy and possessing stolen property taken from residential burglaries, including in New Jersey, which was transported over state lines.
